block_node.block_desc: Automatically update the active configuration parameters of the parent model using a predefined or custom MATLAB file. Double-clicking the block invokes the configuration and optionally builds the model.
block_node.block_open: if ~isequal(get_param(bdroot, 'BlockDiagramType'), 'library') if strcmp(get_param(gcbh, 'ConfigMode'), 'Custom') feval(get_param(gcbh, 'ConfigScript'), getActiveConfigSet(bdroot)) else rtwconfiguremodel(bdroot, get_param(gcbh, 'ConfigMode')) end if strcmp(get_param(gcbh, 'InvokeBuild'), 'on') slbuild(bdroot, 'StandaloneRTWTarget', 'OkayToPushNags', true) endend
